rule: block iff lateCycleRisk=high AND expectationBurden=tight AND lookback60Excess>=20%

rationale: Retained candidates had much higher average/median excess and no excess failures across these three windows.
The rule still blocked seven excess winners, including a large NOR Flash winner, so binary exclusion destroys valid opportunity recall.
Statistical evidence remains weak because the sample is small and historical windows are heterogeneous.
Future work should preserve the raw crowded-continuation state as an opportunity-cost feature and test ranking/sizing separately on untouched windows rather than suppressing the candidate.
